Loss report: concourse -> drone
[lost] pipeline/.shared display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (gets) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config, input_mapping, tags) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (gets) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (config, input_mapping, tags) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider concourse (resources) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared trigger.push: trigger event push, pull_request, tag (the source names no event; a Drone document with no trigger runs on every event, so the list holds the events of a push, a pull request and a tag only)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: each pipeline is a document named <pipeline>-<job> (each document carries its pipeline's trigger condition)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches: ref filter (the filters of the triggers differ, so each is written as a ref: refs/heads/<pattern>, refs/tags/<pattern>, refs/pull/*/head for a pull request on GitHub)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.tags: ref filter refs/tags/<pattern> on the tag event (the glob dialect is doublestar; the parser reads it back as the tag trigger filter, and branch is not available on tag events)
